facts.activity_file: proving overpressure protection is in service

control_failures.control_label: controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems

facts.site: Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop
facts.title: unplanned release of thermal energy at MAG-9602

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control STEAM_SYSTEM_WARM_THROUGH: the controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems was not in place, and the learning team review classified this as an organisational factor.

recommendations: Confirm at the next assurance activity that the controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems on MAG-9602 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in verifying pressure relief and protection, specifically proving overpressure protection is in service. MAG-9602 (explosives magazines) is in service for explosives and detonator storage. The task proceeded during cleaning and preparation while the controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems was not in place. The thermal energy involved is held as hot surface, and the recorded presentation was burn, ignition, scald.
response.summary: On 24 December 2025 a high potential incident was recorded on MAG-9602 at Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop during cleaning and preparation; thermal energy held as hot surface was not released.
